item.text: I’m using the `eco` skill to keep this review concise and token-efficient.

The module calculates order totals, applies `SAVE10`/`SAVE20` discounts, computes average item price, and formats an order summary.

Bugs:

- [test/orders.js:5](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Xa6u83/test/orders.js:5): `i <= items.length` runs one iteration too far, so `items[i]` is `undefined` and `calcTotal` always throws. Use `i < items.length`.
- [test/orders.js:23](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Xa6u83/test/orders.js:23): `averageItemPrice([])` would divide by zero and return `NaN` after fixing `calcTotal`; empty input needs explicit handling.
- Currency arithmetic uses floating-point numbers, which can introduce rounding errors before display or downstream calculations.
